name: Gomennasai... Atashi no Sei de
original_name: ゴメンなさい・・・アタシのせいで
source:
Main character is depressed because he believes there can be no girl to like him. One day such girl appears. He does not believe in her sincerity, so he sets a series of cruel tests to try her love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公十分消沉，认定不可能有女孩喜欢自己。一天，这样的女孩真的出现了。但他不相信她的真心，于是安排了一连串残酷的考验，试图验证她的爱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
